extension.description: Render ```plantuml code blocks in the built-in Markdown preview, preview .puml files, and export diagrams as SVG or PNG. No Java, no server, no network connection — your diagram source is rendered locally.

config.theme.description: Diagram colour palette. "auto" follows the VS Code colour theme. A diagram whose !theme would be hard to read in the palette is drawn in the other one.
config.logLevel.description: Log level for the PlantUML Local output channel. The Output panel's own level selector applies on top of this.
config.exportDirectory.description: Where exported SVGs and PNGs are written, relative to the Markdown file. Use "." for the same folder. Absolute paths and ".." are rejected.
config.exportTheme.description: Palette for exported SVGs and PNGs. Exports face hosts like GitHub whose background this extension does not control, so "light" is the default; "preview" follows the palette the preview currently uses. A diagram whose !theme would be hard to read in the palette is exported in the other one.
config.exportPngScale.description: Scale of an exported PNG: 1, 2 or 4 times the size the diagram gives itself. A PNG larger than 8192 pixels a side or 16 million in all is refused rather than shrunk.
config.hideExportedImages.description: Hide images marked with #plantuml-local in the Markdown preview, so an exported diagram is not shown next to its block's own render. Turn off to check how the exported SVG itself looks.
config.preview.updateMode.description: When a changed diagram is drawn again in the Markdown preview and the .puml preview: "onChange" as you type, "onSave" when the file is saved, "manual" only with PlantUML Local: Clear Render Cache and Re-render. Until then the diagram shown stays, marked as not updated. A diagram shown for the first time is always drawn, and export always uses the current text.
config.diagnostics.enabled.description: Show the problems of the diagrams in open Markdown files in the Problems panel, whether or not a preview is open: engine errors and warnings, and what the bundled engine does not support or drops without a word.
